page_title: LUT 1-3 SHU | Luton v Sheffield Utd 10/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+7' High and wide! Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
90+6' Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
90+4' Andros Townsend (Luton) sends a long ball in, but Wesley Foderingham comfortably gathers the ball.
90+3' Luton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90' 9 additional min. will be played.

90' Andros Townsend (Luton) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the right side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
87' Rob Edwards has decided to make a change. Cauley Woodrow (Luton) replaces Carlton Morris.
87' The referee allows time for a substitution. Alfie Doughty will be replaced by Luke Berry (Luton).
85' The ratio of the ball possession is 73:27.
83' Tahith Chong (Luton) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
81' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. James McAtee is replaced by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd).
81' Substitution. Cameron Archer makes way for Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd).
80' Ross Barkley (Luton) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
78' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
78' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
78' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner.
76' Ross Barkley (Luton) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
75' Alfie Doughty (Luton) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
72' 1 - 3 Goal! Great play by Ben Osborn releases Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 1:3.
70' Luton seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
69' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
68' Substitution. Reece Burke is replaced by Andros Townsend (Luton).
66' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
65' The resulting corner from Alfie Doughty (Luton) comes to nothing.

64' Carlton Morris (Luton) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Wesley Foderingham has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and Luton manage to earn a corner.
64' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Chris Kavanagh who sees an offensive foul.
62' Luton are awarded a free kick near the side line and the players make their way into the box for the inevitable cross.
62' Tahith Chong (Luton) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
59' We are about to witness a subsitution. Tom Davies (Sheffield Utd) for Gustavo Hamer.
59' Gabriel Osho (Luton) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
59' Corner kick. Alfie Doughty (Luton) is ready to send the ball into the box.
57' A lofted cross from Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
56' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
56' Reece Burke (Luton) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
54' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
53' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tahith Chong (Luton) is coming onto the pitch as Jordan Clark cannot continue after picking up an injury.
52' 1 - 2 Goal! Carlton Morris (Luton) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Wesley Foderingham into the bottom right corner.
52' Carlton Morris (Luton) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
52' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
51' Referee Chris Kavanagh makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Luton. Let’s see what happens!
50' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
49' There's an opportunity for Alfie Doughty (Luton) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
48' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+5' Alfie Doughty (Luton) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45+3' Alfie Doughty (Luton) is about to take a corner kick.
45+2' Alfie Doughty (Luton) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. Luton have a corner.
45+2' Chiedozie Ogbene (Luton) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
45' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Alfie Doughty (Luton) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
44' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
44' Jordan Clark (Luton) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
41' Carlton Morris (Luton) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
38' The Luton players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
36' 0 - 2 Goal! Thomas Kaminski gets a hand on the penalty from James McAtee (Sheffield Utd), but can't stop it from flying into the bottom right corner.
36' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
36' Referee Chris Kavanagh awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!

35' It's been a while since that incident in the box, but the ref must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review that earlier penalty shout! What a chance for Sheffield Utd.
34' Reece Burke (Luton) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.

34' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper leaps from the ground and makes a stunning save.
33' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) will deliver the corner kick.
33' Elijah Adebayo (Luton) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post.
30' 0 - 1 Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Thomas Kaminski with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 0:1.
29' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it just wide of the right post.
26' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
25' Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) and Anel Ahmedhodzic matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
24' Carlton Morris (Luton) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
22' Alfie Doughty (Luton) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
20' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) trips an opposition player and Chris Kavanagh signals a foul.
18' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Luton) smashes the ball upfield and Chiedozie Ogbene brings it down with a fine first touch.
17' Alfie Doughty (Luton) sends a cross into the box, but Wesley Foderingham comes off his line to gather the ball.
15' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Alfie Doughty (Luton), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
13' Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Luton failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' What was Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
9' Gabriel Osho (Luton) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
9' Luton have an opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
7' Some great controlled play and passing from Luton. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
5' Rhys Norrington-Davies is being substituted because of an injury. Chris Wilder sends Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) on the pitch.
3' Rhys Norrington-Davies (Sheffield Utd) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
3' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Sheffield Utd will kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh was nominated as the referee for this game.
